system.description:
Your systems are insulated to improve your resistance to Ion damage.

Prerequisites: (Droid and Strength 13) or (Cyborg Hybrid and Constitution 13)

Effect: If the Ion damage (Before being halved) equals or exceeds your Damage Threshold, you move only -1 step on the Condition Track.

Normal: If the Ion damage (Before being halved) equals or exceeds your Damage Threshold, you normally move -2 steps on the Condition Track.
